Callout.Name: Concern for an Elderly Resident
Callout.Message: Care worker reporting bruising on an elderly client.
Callout.Advisory: Client on scene, carer present, no violence reported.

Script.Line: She bruises easily. She is eighty-nine, everybody bruises her.
I have looked after her four years and nobody has complained before.
Ask her yourself. She will tell you.

Lines.Approach: The care worker is describing bruising nobody has explained. Take it seriously and take your time.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
